title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Hovering amid sunken quartz prisms and swaying indigo kelp, this inquisitive little cephalopod busily arranges tumbled pebbles and sea glass into intricate spirals, tapping its favorites together with a crisp click-clack. As it ponders its shiny collection, ripples of warm bioluminescence dance across its mantle like shifting constellations and secret alphabets.
